window-1.title: Anna's Secret Garden
window-1.blurb: Go draw a wonky little flower and leave it for strangers — it's the sweetest, most hand-made corner of the internet and exactly your kind of collaborative side quest.

window-2.title: The Substack Stars: 21 Newsletters Your Favorite Writers Can't Get Enough Of
window-2.blurb: It's a roomful of people with real taste passing you their private reading lists — consider this your rabbit hole for the week, and yes, you're allowed to subscribe to all of them.

window-3.title: Summertime Aguas Frescas
window-3.blurb: Four ingredients and a blender gets you an endlessly remixable fruit-and-lime cooler — cucumber-mint one day, pineapple the next — perfect for Singapore heat and for dressing up in your prettiest glass.

window-4.title: Before & After: A Colorful, Modern Update for a Late 19th-Century Apartment
window-4.blurb: The trick here is painting the trim — window frames, door frames, skirting boards — in colour instead of default white, which turns an old room into something hand-drawn and lived-in, exactly the kind of low-cost, high-commitment side quest you'd finish in a weekend.

window-5.title: Chye Seng Huat Hardware (CSHH Coffee Bar)
window-5.blurb: An old hardware shophouse turned art-deco coffee temple with a 360° island bar you sit around like a stage — bring the film camera, because the green tiles, brass and courtyard light were made for you.
